versions.content: If FrNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE FrNm shall provide the possibility to store external and internal requested PNs combined over all relevant channels (all FrNm channels where FrNmPnEnabled is TRUE). At initialization the values of all PNs shall be set to 0 (not requested)
